```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(VennDiagram)
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")
library(grid)
library(data.table)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm"

result_folder = paste("../../../../Results/ClonalCultures/DNAm",format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),sep="/")
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)
```



```{r}
other_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Other") |> as.data.frame()
loc_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Locations")  |> as.data.frame()
island_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Islands.UCSC")  |> as.data.frame()
colnames(loc_anno) <- c("CHR","MAPINFO","STRAND")
full_anno <- merge(loc_anno, other_anno, by=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
full_anno <- merge(full_anno, island_anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
rownames(full_anno) <- full_anno$Row.names

probes_450k <- rownames(subset(full_anno, Methyl450_Loci==TRUE))
```


```{r}
order_df <- function(d, column, decreasing = F) {return(d[order(d[[column]], decreasing = decreasing),])}
```

```{r}
all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()
```

```{r}
add_gene_symbol <- function(d, gene_name_col = "UCSC_RefGene_Name", cpg_id_col = "Row.names") {
  gg <- strsplit(d[[gene_name_col]], ";")
  tmp <- data.table(rep(d[[cpg_id_col]], times = sapply(gg, length)), unlist(gg)) |> setnames(c("V1","V2"), c("cpg","gene"))
  setorder(tmp, cpg, gene)
  tmp <- unique(tmp)
  xx <- tmp[, .(gene_symbol=paste0(gene, collapse=",")), by="cpg"]
  setkey(xx, "cpg")
  d$gene_symbol = xx[d[[cpg_id_col]]]$gene_symbol
  return(d)
}
```



# IM vs. Non-IM, only new (EPIC) samples

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_annotated.RData") )
im_nonim_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNonIM_592_594_avg"]]
im_nonim_results <- add_gene_symbol(im_nonim_results)
#im_nonim_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste0(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```


We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and raw pvalue < 0.001 as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp =im_nonim_results 

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hyper_cpg_592_594$gene_symbol = strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594

```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 


## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=10}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=10}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5}
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
data(Locations)
i450k_cpgs <- rownames(Locations)

lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) table(x$Row.names %in% i450k_cpgs))

aa <- merge(im_nonim_results, im_nonim_healthy_results, by="Row.names")
aa1 <- subset(aa, adj.P.Val.y < 0.05 & abs(logFC.y)>0.2)
plot(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, pch=20, xlab="IM EPIC",ylab="EPIC_Healthy")
abline(h=0,v=0, lty=2)
abline(a=0, b=1, col="red")

aa <- merge(im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results, im_nonim_healthy_results, by="Row.names")
aa1 <- subset(aa, adj.P.Val.y < 0.05 & abs(logFC.y)>0.2)
plot(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, pch=20, xlab="450k_and_EPIC",ylab="EPIC_Healthy")
abline(h=0,v=0, lty=2)
```

## Hypermethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1","red"),
                  cat.cex = .7)

```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1","red"),

grid.draw(x)
```

## Intersecting hypermethylated genes in IM vs control but not in Non-IM vs Control


```{r}
im_conditions = c("IM_vs_nonIM", "IM_vs_healthy","IM_vs_healthy_450k_and_EPIC")
nonim_conditions = c("nonIM_vs_healthy")
```

### Genes in all IM

```{r}
first = T
for (n in im_conditions) {
  if(first) {
    ii <- all_hyper_cpg[[n]]
    first = F
    next
  } else {
    ii <- subset(ii, gene_symbol %in% all_hyper_cpg[[n]]$gene_symbol) 
  }
}

ii$gene_symbol |> table()

```

### but not in non-IM

```{r}
x <- unique(ii$gene_symbol)
x <- x[!x %in% all_hyper_cpg[[nonim_conditions]]$gene_symbol]
x
```

# Intersecting CpGs 

```{r}
ofile = file.path(result_folder, "Overlapping_CpGs_IM_vs_nonIM_vs_Healthy.xlsx")

res_cols = c("logFC","AveExpr","P.Value","adj.P.Val")
anno_cols = c("Row.names","gene_symbol","CHR","MAPINFO","STRAND","UCSC_RefGene_Name","UCSC_RefGene_Accession","UCSC_RefGene_Group","Phantom4_Enhancers","Phantom5_Enhancers","DMR","X450k_Enhancer","HMM_Island","Regulatory_Feature_Name","Regulatory_Feature_Group","GencodeBasicV12_NAME","GencodeBasicV12_Accession","GencodeBasicV12_Group","GencodeCompV12_NAME","GencodeCompV12_Accession","GencodeCompV12_Group","DNase_Hypersensitivity_NAME","DNase_Hypersensitivity_Evidence_Count","OpenChromatin_NAME","OpenChromatin_Evidence_Count","TFBS_NAME","TFBS_Evidence_Count","Methyl27_Loci","Methyl450_Loci","Random_Loci","Islands_Name","Relation_to_Island")

full_anno <- add_gene_symbol(full_anno)

hyper_cpg_comp = full_anno[, anno_cols]
class(hyper_cpg_comp$Row.names) <- "character"

for (n in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  tmp <- all_hyper_cpg[[n]][, c("Row.names",res_cols)]
  class(tmp$Row.names) <- "character"
  colnames(tmp)[2:ncol(tmp)] <- paste0(res_cols, "__",n)
  
  hyper_cpg_comp <- merge(hyper_cpg_comp, tmp, by="Row.names", all.x=T, sort=F)
}
row_na_cnt = apply(hyper_cpg_comp[, grepl("^logFC",colnames(hyper_cpg_comp))], 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
hyper_cpg_comp <- hyper_cpg_comp[row_na_cnt < length(names(all_hyper_cpg)), ]
hyper_cpg_comp <- hyper_cpg_comp[order(hyper_cpg_comp$CHR, hyper_cpg_comp$MAPINFO), ]


hypo_cpg_comp = full_anno[, anno_cols]
class(hypo_cpg_comp$Row.names) <- "character"

for (n in names(all_hypo_cpg)) {
  tmp <- all_hypo_cpg[[n]][, c("Row.names",res_cols)]
  class(tmp$Row.names) <- "character"
  colnames(tmp)[2:ncol(tmp)] <- paste0(res_cols, "__",n)
  
  hypo_cpg_comp <- merge(hypo_cpg_comp, tmp, by="Row.names", all.x=T, sort=F)
}
row_na_cnt = apply(hypo_cpg_comp[, grepl("^logFC",colnames(hypo_cpg_comp))], 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
hypo_cpg_comp <- hypo_cpg_comp[row_na_cnt < length(names(all_hypo_cpg)), ]
hypo_cpg_comp <- hypo_cpg_comp[order(hypo_cpg_comp$CHR, hypo_cpg_comp$MAPINFO), ]

writexl::write_xlsx(list(hypermethylated=hyper_cpg_comp, hypomethylated=hypo_cpg_comp), path = ofile)
```


... have been exported to file `r ofile`.
